mapped_motor_feedback.classification: nonlinear mapped motor-feedback/current-family proxy sharing the pre-clamp Q-axis aggregate that feeds DID 0x1151
mapped_motor_feedback.semantic_boundary: The source family is now target-natively joined to DID1151's pre-clamp Q-axis aggregate, but B22:B23 is not DID1151 in wire units: a sibling-axis-conditioned lookup and a separate runtime scale intervene. Treat it as a signed motor-feedback/assist proxy, not amperes, commanded torque, or LTA authority. Motor feedback is never by itself proof of an external lateral command: driver EPS assist also creates current.
source_chain: 0x00037E48: dual-channel feedback sums -> FEBE6D70 plus extended Q-axis sum FEBE6D78; saturated FEBE6D72 is the DID1151 upstream source
0x00038678: abs/sign-preserving lookup interpolation over FEBE6D78, conditioned by FEBE6D70
0x0004C490: FEBE6718 plus unsigned scale FEBEE8D8 -> FEBE816C

0x4A3.current_semantic_boundary: F33 0x4A3 uses GP-0x50E8, while DID 0x1151 Motor Actual Current (Q Axis) reads GP-0x50F2. The upstream join is now closed: GP-0x50E8 is a nonlinear sibling-axis-conditioned map of the same extended Q-axis sum that is saturated into the DID1151 source. It is therefore a motor-current-family feedback proxy, but not DID1151 in wire units and not yet amperes or commanded torque.
